name: @gts/desktop
description: Offline-capable guitar transcription and practice workspace
author: Guitar Tab Studio

scripts.build:runtime: npm run build -w @gts/core && npm run build -w @gts/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.bundle:api: esbuild ../api/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=build-resources/api/index.mjs
scripts.dev: cross-env-shell GTS_DESKTOP_DATA_ROOT=./data/preview-user-data "npm run build:runtime && npm run build && electron dist/main.cjs"
scripts.smoke: npm run build:runtime && npm run build && cross-env GTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1 GTS_ENABLE_RESEARCH_MODELS=1 GTS_DESKTOP_DATA_ROOT=./data/smoke-user-data electron dist/main.cjs
scripts.package: npm run bundle:api && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
